questions.explanation: Authentication answers who or what a party is, using secrets, keys, certificates or biometric factors. Authorisation then applies policy to that identity. Message integrity is a separate property, usually provided by a MAC or signature. Conflating these stages leads to systems that know who a user claims to be but make poor decisions about what to allow. The concrete addresses in the case do not change the rule.
